2115148164055654700.en_summary: The $META selloff due to equity dilution is annoying, but Meta and Google each raised about $100B this year as they need capital for AI buildout after FCF disappeared and balance sheets levered. Google flat YTD, Meta red after peaking at $780. $META $25B offering today at $625 was 5x oversubscribed. $NVDA and $AMD invested in $META. $AMZN and $MSFT have not tapped equity markets yet. Opportunity to buy hyperscalers at historically lowest multiples relative to growth if AI capex delivers ROI.
2115148164055654700.zh_summary: 因股權稀釋導致的$META拋售很煩人，但Meta和Google今年各籌集約1000億美元，因為自由現金流消失且資產負債表已槓桿化，它們需要資本進行AI建設。Google年內持平，Meta在達到780美元後轉紅。今天$META以625美元的250億美元發行超額認購5倍。$NVDA和$AMD投資了$META。$AMZN和$MSFT尚未進入股權市場。如果AI資本支出帶來投資回報，則有機會以相對於增長的歷史最低倍數買入超大規模雲端服務商。
